record.evidence_quote: EIS produced an ionic conductivity of 2.6x10-6 S/cm, on the order of those produced in literature via RF sputtering
record.evidence_location: Supporting information, Baseline properties of thin film amorphous LiPON
record.notes: Free-standing RF-sputtered LiPON film; measurement temperature not stated. The main-text Figure 6 caption gives the same value as 2.6 μS/cm for a 3.75 µm free-standing film, which was not recorded separately to avoid duplication. The paper does not give a precise stoichiometry for this film; the NMR-derived composition Li2.93PO3.52N0.30 is for a film of similar conductivity, so it is not attributed here.
